title: The composition isomorphism of pushforwards is monoidal
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a closed braided monoidal Grothendieck abelian category (for instance $\mathcal A=\Ab$), and let $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ be morphisms of schemes. Work with the small pro-étale sites of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with universes large enough for $\mathcal A$-valued sheaves. Use the pushforwards of [def-sfb-finite-lower-star], and on each sheaf category the sheafification of the pointwise tensor, with unit the sheafified constant presheaf at $\mathbf1_{\mathcal A}$ [lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators]. Give each pushforward $h_*$, $h\in\{f,g,g\circ f\}$, its canonical lax monoidal structure induced from restriction of presheaves and sheafification: for $h\colon S\to T$ and sheaves $F,G$ on $S_{\mathrm{proét}}$, the tensor comparison $h_*F\otimes h_*G\to h_*(F\otimes G)$ and the unit comparison $\mathbf1_T\to h_*\mathbf1_S$ are the unique morphisms of sheaves whose composites with the sheafification maps $(V\mapsto F(V\times_TS)\otimes G(V\times_TS))\to h_*F\otimes h_*G$ and $\underline{\mathbf1}\to\mathbf1_T$ are, at each $V$, the components at $V\times_TS$ of the sheafification maps $(W\mapsto F(W)\otimes G(W))\to F\otimes G$ and $\underline{\mathbf1}\to\mathbf1_S$. For symmetric coefficients these are the structure maps of [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-lax-monoidal]. The composition isomorphism $c:g_*\circ f_*\xrightarrow{\sim}(g\circ f)_*$ of [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-comp], induced by $(V\times_ZY)\times_YX\cong V\times_ZX$, is monoidal for the composite lax monoidal structure on $g_*\circ f_*$ and the canonical lax monoidal structure on $(g\circ f)_*$. For symmetric coefficients this tensor is the one of [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor].

proof.text: For $T=X,Y,Z$ let $a_T\dashv U_T$ be sheafification and let $t_T(F,G)$ and $u_T$ be the tensor and unit generators supplied by [lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators]. In particular a map out of $F\otimes G$, respectively $\mathbf1_T$, is determined by its composite with $t_T(F,G)$, respectively $u_T$, on underlying presheaves. These are morphisms in $\mathcal A$ at each site object; no elementwise or concreteness assumption on $\mathcal A$ is made. The small-site convention of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] permits applying the cited result to all three sites in a common sufficiently large universe.

source.place: Proof, sentence 1; replace sectionwise equality after sheafification by the actual universal-property test

proof.text:
For $h:S\to T$, write $r_h$ for restriction of presheaves along $V\mapsto V\times_TS$. By [def-sfb-finite-lower-star], $U_T h_*=r_hU_S$. The strong monoidal sheafification gives its right adjoint $U_T$ the canonical lax structure by [lem-sfb-monoidal-adjunction-mates]; restriction is strong monoidal for pointwise tensor. For sheaves $F,G$ on $S$, the canonical tensor comparison $\mu_h:h_*F\otimes h_*G\to h_*(F\otimes G)$ is the unique extension of $r_h(t_S(F,G))$, and its unit comparison $e_h:\mathbf1_T\to h_*\mathbf1_S$ is the unique extension of $r_h(u_S)$. Indeed their sources are $a_T(r_hU_SF\otimes_p r_hU_SG)$ and $a_T(\underline{\mathbf1})$; restriction strictly preserves the pointwise tensor and constant unit, so the adjunction in [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] gives these extensions. This also identifies the maps with the canonical lax structure obtained by restricting underlying presheaves, sheafifying, and identifying $a_TU_Th_*\cong h_*$ by the counit: the triangle identity says exactly that its composite with the sheafification unit is the restricted map. Thus, at every $V\in T_{\mathrm{proét}}$,
$$
(\mu_h)_{F,G}(V)\circ t_T(h_*F,h_*G)_V=t_S(F,G)_{V\times_TS},\quad
(e_h)_V\circ(u_T)_V=(u_S)_{V\times_TS}.
$$
These are equalities of maps from $F(V\times_TS)\otimes G(V\times_TS)$ and $\mathbf1_{\mathcal A}$, respectively; they do not assert that evaluation commutes with sheaf tensor.

source.place: Proof, sentences 2-3: identify the lax comparison maps on the presheaf generators

proof.text:
Put $k=g\circ f$. For a site object $V$ of $Z$ set $W=(V\times_ZY)\times_YX$ and $W'=V\times_ZX$. By [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-comp], $c_F(V):F(W)\to F(W')$ is restriction along the canonical isomorphism $b:W'\to W$. For sheaves $F,G$ on $X$, the tensor condition is
$$
c_{F\otimes G}\circ g_*(\mu_f)\circ\mu_g
=\mu_k\circ(c_F\otimes c_G).
$$
Precompose both sides with $t_Z(g_*f_*F,g_*f_*G)$. Twice applying the formulas of step 2 makes the left side at $V$ equal to $(F\otimes G)(b)\circ t_X(F,G)_W$. Naturality of $t_Z$ in the sheaf variables, followed by the formula for $\mu_k$, makes the right side equal to $t_X(F,G)_{W'}\circ(F(b)\otimes G(b))$. These two maps agree by presheaf naturality of $t_X(F,G)$ at $b$. The equality-detection assertion of [lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators] proves the displayed tensor condition. This uses exactly the canonical pasting isomorphism, rather than a chosen replacement for it.

source.place: Proof, sentence 3: explicit tensor compatibility along the pasting isomorphism

proof.text:
The composite unit comparison is $g_*(e_f)\circ e_g$. The remaining condition is
$$
c_{\mathbf1_X}\circ g_*(e_f)\circ e_g=e_k.
$$
Precompose on underlying presheaves with $u_Z$. At $V$, step 2 turns the left side into $\mathbf1_X(b)\circ(u_X)_W$, while the right side becomes $(u_X)_{W'}$. These agree by naturality of $u_X:\underline{\mathbf1}_{\mathcal A}\to U_X\mathbf1_X$, because the constant presheaf sends $b$ to $\mathrm{id}_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal A}}$. The unit equality-detection assertion of [lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators] proves the condition. The tensor and unit conditions are precisely the definition of a monoidal natural transformation; $c$ is already a natural isomorphism by [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-comp]. Hence it is a monoidal natural isomorphism.

source.place: Proof, last sentence: explicit unit compatibility and conclusion

lean.statement:
instance ProEtale.isMonoidal_lowerStarComp :
    NatTrans.IsMonoidal (ProEtale.lowerStarComp A f g).hom
lean.note: Exact pro-etale specialization of the previously attached general continuous-site instance. The published source, read through scompile.py --source, binds A : Type u' with Category.{u + 1}, Abelian, IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1}, MonoidalCategory, BraidedCategory and MonoidalClosed, and arbitrary f : X ⟶ Y and g : Y ⟶ Z with X Y Z : Scheme.{u}. Its conclusion uses the canonical lowerStarComp induced by pullbackComp, with the existing composite lax monoidal structure. No additional hypotheses or replacement maps. The current published body applies the general monoidality instance and has no sorry.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-ND-8df9c3f93 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Verdict FIX: the split is sound apart from one missing citation, now repaired. Full review in review.md. Lean: live Monoidal.lean:123 isMonoidal_lowerStarComp is still `:= sorry`, so the item is open and B10 does not apply. The item's lean.note claiming no sorry is stale. STATEMENT-DISPUTED is correct: sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor and the other existing sheaf-tensor nodes assume symmetric coefficients, while the blueprint item and the Lean assume only braided. Counterexample checked: Z-graded Q-vector spaces with braiding 2^{mn}·swap satisfy the hexagons, and the double braiding in degree (1,1) is 4. The delivery keeps the braided generality, the canonical map c and the target. The new node lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators is true: A is closed and complete, so presheaf internal homs exist and the internal hom into a sheaf is a sheaf, making the local isos stable under tensoring and sheafification strong braided; the Hom bijections are the adjunction a ⊣ U. Project GrothendieckAbelian/Monoidal/Defs.lean corroborates it under exactly the same hypotheses. It is statement-only and self-contained, it is not a restated clause of the item, and every existing candidate is symmetric-only, so it is not a duplicate. I recomputed steps 2–4 component by component: μ_h and e_h as unique extensions of the restricted sheafification maps; the tensor axiom reduces to (F⊗G)(b)∘t_X,W = t_X,W'∘(F(b)⊗G(b)), naturality of t_X at b: W'→W; the unit axiom reduces to naturality of u_X with const(b) = id. Equality detection then concludes. No symmetry is used and no SGA is cited. FIX (B3/missing citation): the item defined the pushforward lax structure inline and did not cite the existing def-sfb-finite-lower-star-lax-monoidal. That node's blueprint proof defines exactly these maps, and the citer def-sfb-module-lower-star-comp (A = Ab) transports module objects along them. The corrected item statement now gives the two comparison maps explicitly, as in step 2, says they are the structure maps of def-sfb-finite-lower-star-lax-monoidal for symmetric coefficients, and adds that node to stmt_deps (no cycle). Steps are unchanged.
